entities.title: zazz::test library
entities.summary: What a script's tests can rely on from the harness, the fakes and the checks.
consumers: Script authors' tests, typically Harness::from_manifest(handlers(), include_str!("../zazz.json")) (agents/skills/zazz/SKILL.md; the tests `zazz new` writes)
The test file of zazzled's `zazz new` template (macos/rust/zazzled/src/zazz/setup.rs) and the scripts zazzled's tests build (macos/rust/zazzled/src/zazz/mod.rs)
guarantees: Harness::new allows everything: no filesystem or network policy, working directory /work, clock at 1704067200000 ms (2024-01-01), empty stdin and environment.

Harness::from_manifest applies sandbox.read (default ["$CWD"]), sandbox.write (default []) and sandbox.network ("all", {"hosts": [...]}, otherwise none) as production would, and the cli spec for human runs; a manifest that is not JSON, or a bad cli spec, panics.

json_command and service_call run as an agent; human(argv) parses argv with the cli spec (or passes {"argv": [...]} without one), renders the output as for a non-terminal, and returns the Outcome: exit 2 on a parse error, at least 1 when the handler fails, help text with exit 0.

FakeFs paths are normalised to $CWD, $TMP, $HOME or absolute paths; a '..' that leaves its root is sandbox_denied; reading is allowed under the read or the write rules, writing under the write rules; deny and fail_write inject failures; written, written_text and written_paths show what the call wrote.

FakeHttp applies the network policy before anything else, records every request, answers a request from the matching expectation by method and URL (the least-used first, so repeated expectations are consumed in turn), and panics on an unexpected request; replay loads [{"request": {"method", "url"}, "response": {"status", "headers", "json" | "text"}}]; assert_all_used panics if an expectation was never used.
assert_snapshot(name, value) compares with NAME.json in the snapshot directory and panics on a difference or a missing file; with updating on it writes the file instead (configuration.json).

check_schema checks the subset type, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties false, items and local $ref; response_schema finds an operation's application/json schema for 200, 201 or default.
entities.compatibility: Ships with the SDK and has the same policy (macos/rust/zazz-sdk/src/.dev/contracts.json, script-api).
